Messages.Body:
Some Question for the Rules Team

Computer Hacking

Is this the only directed bleed action which may be used to target
any Methuselah which does not specifically say so? ie Night
Moves says that it can target predator or prey whilst Govern the
Unaligned does not specifically say so.

Psyche! vs Illusions of the Kindred

If I play Psyche! immediately after someone plays Illusions of the
Kindred do I begin combat again with the vampire attempting to
bring out the illusionary vampire. It appears that this is
possible after the card text "Combat ends." on Illusions of the
Kindred and before the next sentence takes effect. Also following
this, if my vampire enters torpor as a result of combat with the
initial vampire then does the illusionary vampire come out and
then leave play with no effect?

Blood Brother Ambush and Ghouled Street Thug

What is the innate hand damage of these allies?

Is the answer

a) 0, because they have 2R and 1R damage respectively

b) 1, because they are allies and there is some rule somewhere
that all minions have an innate hand damage of 1

c) 2 and 1 respectively, because they can do 2R and 1R
respectively

Brujah Debate

Are multiple Brujah Debates cumulative, ie does two Debates mean
each Brujah gets +2 hand damage and two optional maneuvers each
combat?

White Phosphorous Grenade

Is the text "each strike" obsolete or not. Is the grenade burned
after the first strike after the first round of combat or after
the end of combat?

Shackles of Enkidu

Can the Shackles be burned before they have been activated?

Madness Network

Looking at the rulings already made I find it perplexing why a
Malkavian cannot play any action cards when it isn't your turn.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <8496648...@dejanews.com>,

s940...@student.anu.edu.au wrote:
>
> Some Question for the Rules Team
>
> Computer Hacking
>
> Is this the only directed bleed action which may be used to target
> any Methuselah which does not specifically say so? ie Night
> Moves says that it can target predator or prey whilst Govern the
> Unaligned does not specifically say so.

All (D) bleeds (except cardless ones) can target any Methuselah (except
the acting Methuselah). This is official errata. Some cards (like
Night Moves) have cards text which the RT interprets as restricting
the available targets.

(All copies of the rulebook, as well as the initial concept and original
card set texts support the position that you can only bleed you Prey unless
a card (like Night Moves) adds explicit card text to expand the available
target list. But, the RT has different ideas)

> Psyche! vs Illusions of the Kindred
>
> If I play Psyche! immediately after someone plays Illusions of the
> Kindred do I begin combat again with the vampire attempting to
> bring out the illusionary vampire. It appears that this is
> possible after the card text "Combat ends." on Illusions of the
> Kindred and before the next sentence takes effect. Also following
> this, if my vampire enters torpor as a result of combat with the
> initial vampire then does the illusionary vampire come out and
> then leave play with no effect?

By the ruling of Psyche! vs. Form of Mist (which is a simpler situation,
so the ruling may not be applicable), I'd say that Psyche! will terminate
the special combat of Illusionary Kindred (either leaving the would-be
Illusionary vampire at the bottom of the crypt, or removing him from the
game - I don't know) and simply put the Illusionist back into a second
combat with his original (Psyche!ing) opponent.

> Blood Brother Ambush and Ghouled Street Thug
>
> What is the innate hand damage of these allies?
>
> Is the answer
>
> a) 0, because they have 2R and 1R damage respectively

This is correct. It also applies to the Magi (Tremere Allies) and
the Slashers. If an ally's only innate strike is a ranged (or
range-capable) strike, then the ally has zero hand damage.

> Brujah Debate
>
> Are multiple Brujah Debates cumulative, ie does two Debates mean
> each Brujah gets +2 hand damage and two optional maneuvers each
> combat?

Yes. (And each Meth. still only taps her highest (single) Brujah (twice)).

> White Phosphorous Grenade
>
> Is the text "each strike" obsolete or not. Is the grenade burned
> after the first strike after the first round of combat or after
> the end of combat?

After the first strike in which it is used. "Each strike" is part
of the standard weapon-effect template, and just happens to be
superfluous on this weapon.

> Shackles of Enkidu
>
> Can the Shackles be burned before they have been activated?

By card text, yes.
Hopefully a ruling will come along one of these days to errata
that into something more sensible (like "No." :-)

> Madness Network
>
> Looking at the rulings already made I find it perplexing why a
> Malkavian cannot play any action cards when it isn't your turn.

Because the Designers had an oversight (regarding Reaction cards)
when they wrote the original rulebook. That oversight has now
become the accepted standard for handling the Madness Network.

12. Basic Rules "The golden rule for cards":
Whenever the cards contradict the rules, the cards take precedence.

Put this piece of text on the wall, it helps alot during Rule fights.
